title: Replacement Relief on a FlexLine Returned-Payment Fee
content:
When a payment on a FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line was returned and the borrower has made a replacement payment recorded against that return, Larkspur grants replacement relief on the returned-payment fee of that return without a request, booked as one courtesy fee-waiver entry against the fee on the day it is granted, taken off the outstanding balance and counted as a courtesy waiver; the relief is never more than the fee it is booked against, and the window of the fee-waiver policy still applies. A relief that computes to 0.00 for a replaced return whose fee is booked is still booked, as a 0.00 entry against that fee; with no fee booked against the return, or no replacement payment recorded against it, there is nothing to book.

## Courtesy-waiver basis

A courtesy waiver of a late or returned-payment fee is granted on request when fewer than the tier's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the line; workout relief on a past-due line closed to new draws and replacement relief on the fee of a replaced returned payment are courtesy waivers Larkspur grants without a request, each under its own policy, still only while fewer than the tier's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the line.

## When the relief is fixed

Replacement relief is fixed only after the returned payment it is for carries its returned-payment fee entry.

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Occasion | a replacement payment is recorded against a returned payment |
| Request needed | no |
| Entry | one courtesy fee-waiver entry against the returned-payment fee, dated the day it is granted |
| Effect | taken off the outstanding balance; counted as a courtesy waiver |
| Courtesy count and request window | both still apply |
| No fee booked against the return, or no replacement recorded | nothing to book |

## Relief tool: `grant_returned_fee_relief_6fbb0f32`

**What it does.** Books one fee-waiver entry with the basis courtesy on the line, dated the current day and tied to the returned-payment fee it relieves, and takes the relief off the line's outstanding balance. The borrower sees the relief on the account and the lower balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `grant_returned_fee_relief_6fbb0f32` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `credit_line_id` — reference number of the FlexLine, read from the FlexLine account lookup. Identifier.
- `related_txn_id` — reference number of the returned-payment-fee entry the relief is booked against, read from the FlexLine entry lookup for that line. Identifier.
- `relief_amount` — the relief granted, in USD as a decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; no currency sign.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `line_txn_id` (reference number of the new waiver entry), `related_txn_id` (the fee it is booked against), `amount` (the relief, USD with 2 decimal places), `waiver_reason` (courtesy) and `outstanding_balance` (the balance after the relief, USD with 2 decimal places). The new `line_txn_id` confirms the relief was booked.
